The '''Coruscant Opera''' was an [[Opera/Legends|opera]] house on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Possibly the most prestigious and exclusive art house in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], the building itself was built in a [[Old Republic Baroque]] design that predated the formation of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and included an actual orchestra pit. The Opera's wealthiest patrons could reserve private viewing balconies; with individual, leveled seating for all others. For the less fortunate, the Opera included a group of built-in [[Holorecorder/Legends|holorecorders]] which transmitted each performance live so that those who could not afford to physically attend could still view the show.

During the [[Rise of the Empire era|last years]] of the Galactic Republic, the Coruscant Opera was a favorite locale of [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]] and, as a result, many other members of the Galactic elite. When Valorum's planned attendance at a showing became known, ticket prices automatically were raised astronomically. His successor [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], favored the [[Galaxies Opera House/Legends|Galaxies Opera House]]. It was at the Coruscant Opera that the opera ''[[The Brief Reign of Future Wraiths]]'' was first performed in [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]] after returning to the capital from twenty years of touring. In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], they presented ''[[The Agony of Tarkin]]''.

==Behind the scenes==
As stated in [[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']], the Coruscant Opera is separate from the [[Galaxies Opera House/Legends|Galaxies Opera House]].
